turns.content: A spaceship moves at 0.5c along the +x direction relative to Earth. In the spaceship frame, a forward-fired bullet has components (0.3c, 0.1c, 0.3c). Derive the Lorentz velocity-addition formulas needed to obtain the Earth-frame components.
For the boost just specified, calculate the Lorentz factor and the common denominator in the longitudinal and transverse velocity transformations.
Use those quantities to calculate all three components of the bullet velocity in the Earth frame.
Find the magnitude of the Earth-frame velocity vector from those components.
Check the component arithmetic and verify that the resulting speed is below c.
Report the Earth-frame components and speed to a sensible precision.
